title: FEA-SLT: A Gloss-Free End-to-End Framework for Facial-Expression-Aware Sign Language Translation
abstract: arXiv:2601.03549v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sign Language Translation (SLT) is a challenging cross-modal task requiring joint modeling of manual articulations and non-manual signals. Existing gloss-free SLT methods effectively capture gestural dynamics but often underutilize facial expressions, which play crucial grammatical and disambiguating roles. This limitation can cause semantic degradation when distinct concepts share similar manual configurations. To address this issue, we propose FEA-SLT (**F**acial-**E**xpression-**A**ware **S**ign **L**anguage **T**ranslation), a gloss-free end-to-end framework that uses facial dynamics to provide complementary cues to manual signals. FEA-SLT employs a domain-transferred facial encoder to extract expression-sensitive representations and integrates them with manual features through a linguistically motivated *Facial-Expression-Aware Fusion* (FEAF) module. FEAF captures reciprocal dependencies between manual and facial channels

translated_title: FEA-SLT：一种表情感知的无注释端到端手语翻译框架
translated_abstract: 手语翻译（SLT）是一项具有挑战性的跨模态任务，需要对手部动作和非手动信号进行联合建模。现有的无注释SLT方法能够有效捕捉手势动态，但往往未能充分利用面部表情，而面部表情在语法表达和语义消歧方面发挥着关键作用。当不同概念具有相似的手部配置时，这一局限性会导致语义退化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了FEA-SLT（表情感知手语翻译），这是一个无注释的端到端框架，利用面部动态为手部信号提供互补线索。FEA-SLT采用领域迁移的面部编码器提取表情敏感的表示，并通过具有语言学动机的表情感知融合（FEAF）模块将其与手部特征进行整合。FEAF能够捕捉手部通道与面部通道之间的相互依赖关系。
tldr: 提出FEA-SLT，一种无注释端到端手语翻译框架，通过领域迁移面部编码器和表情感知融合模块（FEAF）将面部表情信息与手部动作特征融合，从而在手部配置相似时解决语义歧义问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes FEA-SLT, a gloss-free end-to-end sign language translation framework that integrates facial expressions with manual features via a domain-transferred facial encoder and a Facial-Expression-Aware Fusion module, resolving semantic ambiguity when distinct concepts share similar manual configurations.
